english_text: With all due respect I appreciate the decision the House has taken but this has not been a secret ballot . I know how all of my neighbouring colleagues have voted . I appreciate that if we want to have an open ballot we can do so , but then we should not pretend that we have been voting secretly . We should vote openly by a show of hands . Secondly , I should like to say to our colleagues in the PPE-DE Group that with all due respect , we could have used ballot papers in the same time as we have taken now . Perhaps we can now proceed in a way that is really secret .
